 Oprah's Favorite Things 2026 holiday guide is live — these are the best gifts under $100
 This year's lineup includes 'the perfect white shirt,' Darn Tough socks and more wallet-friendly buys that Lady O swears by.
 Amanda Garrity Follow Editor, Home & Gifts Updated Sun, November 15, 2026 at 6:49 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Updated Sun, November 15, 2026 at 6:49 PM UTC Our experts independently review everything we recommend. If you buy through our links, we may earn commission.
 If Oprah loves it, we love it. Take a peek at the gift-giving queen's top picks for 2026 — from household heroes to beauty standouts. (Frazer Harrison via Getty Images) So, you're not one of those people who has gift-giving down to a science? With the holiday season fast approaching and the gift list getting longer by the day, you may be tempted to panic. But not so fast, my friend! Mother Oprah is here to the rescue with the latest installment of Oprah's Favorite Things , and it's chock full of presents that will please everyone in your life.
 Quick Overview Tankaneo Cropped White Shirt
 $27 at Amazon Melifluos Reversible Poncho
 $37 at Amazon Truff Culinary Gift Set
 $40 at Amazon Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Midweight Hiking Socks 
 More options $26 at Amazon Sunday Silks 3D Contoured Eye Mask
 $40 at Amazon See 5 more Time is of the essence this time of year, so I've sifted through this year's faves to find the best Christmas gift ideas under $100. So, what caught my eye? There are cold-weather cozies, kitchen workhorses, style standouts and tons of affordable finds that make great stocking stuffers (hint, hint). Faves from Darn Tough, Gap and more Amazon-friendly brands made the cut. Keep in mind that when Oprah speaks, people tend to listen, so I wouldn't be surprised if some of these buys sell out before  Black Friday .
 Amazon
 Tankaneo Cropped White Shirt 
 Save Even Lady O can't resist a great Amazon find. Over the years, she's introduced us to statement puffers (remember "the Amazon coat" of 2019?), chic matching sets and faux-fur beauties. But in 2026, she's giving us "the perfect white shirt" — her words, not mine. That may sound like a bold claim, but hundreds of Amazon reviewers stand by it since the button-down is 100% cotton and has a slightly cropped, petite-friendly fit.
 "I bought it myself off Amazon, and then saw one just like it in a boutique in Santorini for 15 times the price! I walked out so proud," she wrote.
 $27 at Amazon Amazon
 Melifluos Reversible Poncho 
 Save Sizing is often a guessing game. And while you can always get a gift receipt and call it a day, follow Oprah's lead with this one-size-fits-most option. She wrote: "This shawl is made with a bamboo-based, cashmere-like soft fabric that the person in your life who’s always cold will appreciate." Use it as a travel blanket, drape it over your shoulders or wear it like a scarf — one shawl, so many possibilities!
 $37 at Amazon Amazon
 Truff Culinary Gift Set 
 Save Sixth time's the charm! Oprah first picked Truff in 2018, and the heat hasn't let up. This go-round, she's bringing triple the flavor with this packaged trio, which includes a white truffle hot sauce, white truffle oil and smoky pineapple hot sauce.
 $40 at Amazon Amazon
 Darn Tough Hiker Micro Crew Midweight Hiking Socks 
 Save A sock is a sock, right? Not according to Oprah. “These are the socks I trust on a trail," she raves, adding that they're made with breathable merino wool that "keeps your feet dry no matter the weather."
 At $26 a pair, they're certainly an investment, but a good one at that. Darn Tough says their socks are unconditionally guaranteed for life, which means you can send back worn-out pairs for a replacement. You don't even need to track down your receipt!
 $26 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $26 at REI Amazon
 Sunday Silks 3D Contoured Eye Mask 
 Save A restful night's sleep is worth its weight in gold. Oprah claims the right eye mask is the secret to snoozing soundly: "Wearing one has changed the way I sleep forever, and I promise, they’ll use it every single night."
 This one has contoured cups to frame the eyes and seal out unwanted light, making it a handy option for daytime nappers, frequent travelers and light-sensitive sleepers.
 $40 at Amazon Amazon
 Ridge Power Bank 
 Save There's some flashier (read: more expensive) tech on Oprah's list, but this 5-in-1 power bank is hands-down the most useful. Power up all of your everyday gadgets — you can wirelessly charge your phone and Apple Watch, plus there are two built-in charging cables so you don't have to carry around extra cords.
 "It holds enough juice for three full phone charges—plus a kickstand so they can keep scrolling while it works," Oprah wrote.
 $69 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $69 at Best Buy Amazon
 Amazon Basics Ceramic Nonstick Cookware Set 
 Save A solid cookware set generally costs a pretty penny, but here's a case where you can get three saucepans and a frying pan for the price of one (give or take). "I love giving this set to anyone moving into their first house," Oprah adds.
 The pots and pans can go from the stovetop to the oven (up to 450°F) with the lids and handles removed. The pots, pans and lids are dishwasher-safe, but wash the handles by hand. Pop the handles off for easy stacking and storage.
 $56 at Amazon Amazon
 Anastasia Beverly Hills Velvet Muse Lip Trio 
 Save Anastasia Soare — yes, the Anastasia behind Anastasia Beverly Hills — first shaped Oprah's brows on The Oprah Winfrey Show back in 1998. Nearly 30 years later, the media mogul's waxing poetic about the brand's lip mousse since it's long-lasting, non-drying and leaves a soft-matte finish. Get the bestselling Hush Rose, plus two new shades (a berry red and fig brown) in this trio — they come to about $16 a pop!
 $49 at Amazon Explore More Buying Options $49 at Nordstrom Rack Amazon
 Feppo Electric Warming Tray 
 Save Oprah breaks out these warming trays during holiday buffet dinners, and I'm sure your hostess with the mostest will do the same. "These work beautifully, have 10 heat settings and look good on any counter," she says. Snap in the ones you need or use all for panels four bigger spreads.
 $95 at Amazon Gap
 Gap Denim Five Pocket Tote Bag 
 Save Gap recently dropped a line of bags inspired by the denim that made 'em famous. And while the larger versions have been sold out for quite some time, you can still snag the mini, which is the most versatile of the bunch since it can also be worn crossbody.
 "The rare gift that covers nieces, aunties and grandmothers," gushes Oprah.
